correctness_gate: requires separately recorded negative controls and independent verification

scope.condition: Same trusted local Python execution environment and deterministic native Engine. Sources, arithmetic and native executable retain all legacy identity-check boundaries. Hashes identify bytes and do not defeat replacement followed by restoration between observations.
scope.cross_variant_equivalence: Canonical complete issue bytes, including request, owner receipt time, native snapshot and full certificates, must match. Profiles have different fingerprints, adapter labels and consequently journal heads; receipts must replay exactly within their own profile.
scope.integrity_policy: No verification coalescing or epoch shortcut is used. The strict batch profile binds its additional production module bytes and retains every inherited guard site. Adapter fingerprints and journal heads may differ because the implementations differ.
preserved_work: same exact Engine input and new native process
same represented matrix and exact dyadic source
same SQLite journal and synchronization setting
same fresh Store creation and bind/observe transactions
same atomic rejection and external head/event anchors
